description: This file defines the ECUEditor class, which serves as the main component of an ECU (Engine Control Unit) editing tool within the RomRaider project. It manages UI setup, opening and closing of ECU images (ROMs), and interaction with various components like menus, toolbars, and panels. It also contains inner classes that handle background tasks such as opening, closing, and logging for ECU images.

classes.name: LaunchLoggerWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker that manages launching the ECU logger in a background thread.

classes.name: SetUserLevelWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker responsible for updating displayed tables based on user level settings.

classes.name: CloseImageWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker to handle closing and cleaning up a ROM image in the background.

classes.name: OpenImageWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker that handles opening and parsing a ROM image, including ECU definition lookup, in a background thread.

methods.name: initializeEditorUI
methods.description: Sets up the main UI components such as menu bar, toolbars, and layout.

methods.name: checkDefinitions
methods.description: Checks if ECU definition files are configured; prompts the user to download if not.

methods.name: showReleaseNotes
methods.description: Displays release notes if the software version has changed.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the application is closing, saves settings.

methods.name: addRom
methods.description: Adds a ROM/ECU image to the project, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: displayTable
methods.description: Displays a table in the UI, checking if it's already open.

methods.name: removeDisplayTable
methods.description: Removes a table frame from the UI.

methods.name: closeImage
methods.description: Initiates closing of the currently selected ROM image.

methods.name: getLastSelectedRom
methods.description: Returns the last selected Rom object.

methods.name: setLastSelectedRom
methods.description: Sets the last selected Rom object.

methods.name: openImage
methods.description: Loads a ROM image file into the editor, delegating to background worker.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file into a byte array.

methods.name: launchLogger
methods.description: Begins launch of the ECU logger in a background thread.
